sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "schedule"."Film_ID" AS e, "film"."Directed_by" AS g, SUM("schedule"."Show_times_per_day") AS m1 FROM "schedule" JOIN "film" ON "film"."Film_ID" = "schedule"."Film_ID"  GROUP BY "schedule"."Film_ID", "film"."Directed_by"), "s2" AS (SELECT SUM("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m1" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
why: total of number of showings per day per film within film.Directed_by (additive)
share of the all total of total of number of showings per day (all level)
rank within the group by total of number of showings per day, keep the top 3
